v2.intro: Build interfaces from state and the answers that depend on it. Solid connects those reads to precise updates, whether the answer is ready now or arrives later.
v2.announcement: Explore the new tutorial, project setup, and migration guide

principles.label: Small updates
principles.description: JSX compiles to DOM bindings. A state change updates the parts that read it.

principles.label: Derived answers
principles.description: Calculate what follows from state instead of keeping another copy in sync.

principles.label: Owned work
principles.description: Give state, subscriptions, and cleanup the lifetime of a component or branch.

principles.label: Async by design
principles.description: Keep promises in the reactive graph and choose where loading and error states belong.

example.headline: Change the state. Follow the result.
copy: Click the counter, then watch its doubled value follow. The signal holds writable state; the derived function calculates an answer. Each binding tracks the values it reads.
The component sets up those relationships once. Change the formula in the editor and try it again. You do not need an effect to synchronize the two numbers.
example.hint: Edit the source or click the counter in Preview.

ownership.headline: State lives where you put it.
ownership.copy: A component or control-flow branch owns its reactive work. Put local state with the UI that uses it, share a state factory when several components need it, and return cleanup when external work should stop with its owner.

async.headline: An answer can take time.
async.copy: An async memo describes data that depends on state. Boundaries decide how that work appears in the UI. First readiness, a pending change, and a server write each have a different job.

steps.title: Show the first answer
steps.copy: Read an async result under Loading. Use Errored to give failures a recovery path.
steps.label: Read async data

steps.title: Keep useful content
steps.copy: Let the current answer stay visible while the next one arrives. Use isPending to show that a change is on its way.
steps.label: Handle pending changes

steps.title: Write, then reconcile
steps.copy: Coordinate mutations with actions. Refresh authoritative reads and use optimistic state for a temporary view.
steps.label: Build an action

features.headline: Primitives that compose into an app.
features.copy: Use the same model for local interactions, structured state, async data, and rendering. Add routing or server behavior as your project needs it.

performance.copy: For performance comparisons, check the framework version, browser, and test being measured.
